playbookOutputs: Submitted Section 32 / Section 83 PAIA Annual Report on the Information Regulator Portal
Official Information Regulator PAIA Annual Report Submission Receipt
playbookCommonFailures: Entity has not yet registered its Information Officer on the Information Regulator eServices portal (prerequisite before PAIA Annual Report tab unlocks)
Information Regulator eServices login credentials unknown or OTP sent to an inactive email address

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, CIPC Registration Number & Registered Information Officer Full Name and Email
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the registered company name, CIPC registration number, and the name and email address of your registered Information Officer.

informationToProvide.label: Number of PAIA requests received during the financial year
informationToProvide.aiHint: Enter 0 if no formal access to information requests were lodged with your business.

informationToProvide.label: Information Officer Registration Reference (if available)
informationToProvide.aiHint: The reference number received when the Information Officer was registered.

informationToProvide.label: Information Regulator eServices Portal Username / Email
Information Regulator eServices Portal Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Your Information Regulator eServices portal password (stored encrypted).
